schema_rules.description: Name should not be null in movies metadata
Name should not contain mojibake or control characters
Year should not be null in movies metadata
Year should mostly follow the dominant pattern
Year should be a movie year in [1880, 2035]
Year should not contain mojibake or control characters
Release Date should not be null in movies metadata
Release Date should be parseable as a release date, usually containing a year and optionally country
Release Date year should usually agree with Year, allowing small differences for delayed country releases

Director should not be null in movies metadata

Director should not contain mojibake or control characters

Country should not be null in movies metadata

Duration should not be null in movies metadata

RatingValue should mostly follow the dominant pattern
